title: Sharp bounds for off-diagonal and tripartite canonical Ramsey numbers
summary: The canonical Ramsey theorem establishes that for every positive integer $t$, there is a sufficiently large $n$ such that every edge-colouring of a complete graph $K_n$ contains a copy of $K_t$ that is canonically coloured, i.e. monochromatic, rainbow, or lexicographic. In this paper we investigate two variations of this theorem. First, we study canonical Ramsey numbers in the multipartite hypergraph setting. We prove that in every edge-colouring of the 3-uniform complete hypergraph on at least $t^{151t^2}$ vertices, there always exists a canonically coloured copy of $K_{t, t, t}^{(3)}$.…
